prompt: Changing a response field's type would break mobile app versions still installed on users' phones.

why: Release the change as v2; keep v1 until old apps are gone.

prompt: Adding a new optional field to a response doesn't require a new version, but removing one does.
why: Additive changes are compatible; breaking ones need a version.

prompt: Clients of v1 receive a Deprecation header and a sunset date months ahead.
why: Planned deprecation is part of versioning.
trap: Headers here communicate lifecycle, not auth.

prompt: Each API customer is pinned to the version from the date they signed up, and upgrades when they choose.
tells: pinned to the version from the date they signed up
